subject: Deployment mode sanity check + migration constraints (post-demo)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@novus.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode sanity check + migration constraints (post-demo)

Hi Alice — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can line up the right path (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and put a realistic procurement/implementation timeline on the table.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary workload: high-throughput customer-facing chat (peak ~1,200 reqs/min, median payloads ~400 tokens).
- Current stack: self-hosted GPU cluster (NVIDIA A100 v2), internal KV cache, OpenAI API used for a small portion of experimental features.
- Constraints: SOC2 in progress, strict data residency for EU customers (but initial rollout US-only), need for predictable latency under 250ms p95.

Questions / requests for us
1) Migration source: can you confirm which calls you want to move off the OpenAI API vs what is staying on the existing GPU cluster? (We heard 'all production traffic' but want an explicit scope.)
2) If Dedicated capacity is preferred, is Novus comfortable with a reserved monthly commit or do you need a flexible burst/spot-style option?
3) For Private (VPC) mode: do you have an existing VPC peering/KMS approach we should integrate with? Any air-gap requirements?

Proposed next steps
- If you confirm scope (Q1), we can produce a short TCO/latency note comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private tailored to your token profile (deliverable: redwood-deploy-options-summary.xlsx).
- Schedule a 60-min ops deep-dive (networking/KMS/procurement) with Novus DevOps and our SREs to validate cutover windows and routing playbook.

I attached the two files you shared during the call (novus-mvp-architecture.pdf) and a quick options summary from our side.

Availability: I have Tues/Wed next week afternoons PT for the ops deep-dive. Let me know what works and confirm the scope for migration.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: novus-mvp-architecture.pdf (received from Alice)
Attachment: redwood-deploy-options-summary.xlsx (attached)

From: Alice Chen <alice@novus.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@novus.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Deployment mode sanity check + migration constraints (post-demo)

Markus — thanks for the write-up and for the time today. Couple of clarifications from our side: we are leaning toward Dedicated to guarantee throughput and isolation, but we need answers to a few operational questions before we can commit to an annual reserved pool.

Short answers:
- Migration scope: production chat traffic should move off OpenAI API (experimental features can remain on OpenAI for now). Our internal cluster will be decomissioned once Redwood Dedicated is live for the main traffic.
- Procurement: procurement needs an expected lead time for Dedicated (approx ETA for initial capacity), and a clear failover plan if we need to fall back to the existing cluster during rollouts.
- Private/VPC: we do not require air-gapped on day 1, but will need KMS integration and the ability to keep logs in our logging account (not redwood-managed).

Two asks for Redwood before next week ops call:
1) Estimated capacity footprint (GPUs / baseline qps / token throughput) and an initial cost band for both Dedicated and Hosted for our 12-month forecast.
2) A simple cutover playbook outline (health checks, rollback triggers, partial traffic ramp schedule).

We attached the Novus MVP architecture we referenced in the call. I can do Wed 30 Jun 10:00–11:30 PT for the ops deep-dive; would prefer that slot if it works for your SREs.

Thanks — Alice
VP Product, Novus AI

Marissa — can you produce a back-of-envelope capacity estimate for Novus's reported peak (1,200 reqs/min, median 400 tokens) with two options: (A) Dedicated (reserved baseline + 30% burst) and (B) Hosted (autoscale with burst). Please include estimated monthly costs and expected p95 latency assumptions for each. Deliverable by Tue EOD please.

Soojin — can you put together a VPC/KMS checklist and a minimal AR/AL (audit retention) note explaining what we can expose to Novus's logging account vs what remains in Redwood control plane. Also outline how quick a private peering setup usually is (days/weeks) and what we need from Novus (account IDs, allowed CIDR ranges).

I'll draft a one-page cutover playbook and share before Wed. We should aim to have the cost band and the VPC checklist ready so the ops call is decision-grade.

Thanks — Markus
